releases.synopsis: Zada climbed the filigreed steps to the grandest stage in the grandest room of City Hall, struggling to school her thoughts into something befitting the joyous occasion of her friend's marriage, and away from a swelling, choking fear that she was about to ruin the most important day of Flora's life.

releases.title: Burn the Water
releases.synopsis: **From award-winning screenwriter of *The Hunger Games* Billy Ray comes an immersive and breathtaking enemies-to-lovers epic romance about war, loyalty, and the power that love has to save... or destroy.**

releases.title: Arteria
releases.synopsis: Arteria is a city-building and traffic simulation game. Build roads, intersections and tram lines, and watch the city grow on its own along the routes you lay down. Clear traffic jams, plan efficient transport and turn a small village into a thriving metropolis.

releases.title: Kinetile
releases.synopsis:
Kinetile is a 3D physics puzzle game about getting one rolling ball to the finish. Drag arrows, jumps, teleports and bouncers into place, then press Start: the board locks and your plan plays out. Watch the ball clear a gap, ricochet into a turn and emerge from a teleport exactly where you planned.

The game has 56 handcrafted levels in two packs. CLASSIC PATHS introduces the tools across 28 levels, from the first turns to routes combining long jumps, teleports and gates controlled by buttons. FORGED PATHS adds 28 puzzles with denser boards, where buttons set sliding platforms in motion and fill gaps in a cascade, so a bridge has to slide into place before the ball arrives.

Infinity mode generates a new puzzle every time on Normal or Hard difficulty. Each board has a seed code that can be copied to replay it or to challenge a friend to solve the same board.

There is no timer or move limit. Stop a run or let the ball fall, and the tiles return to the arrangement you prepared, ready to adjust and try again.

releases.title: Cat Simulator
releases.synopsis: Cat Simulator is an adorable game where you play as a mischievous little cat! Explore cozy rooms, interact with all kinds of objects, pull playful pranks, and knock things over just for fun. Jump around, collect stars, and unlock new rooms to continue your curious adventure. Ready to cause some cute chaos?

releases.title: Dongda Gangster
releases.synopsis: DONGDA Gangster is a live-action interactive narrative game based on the popular Chinese IP Northeast Past, set in Northeast China during the 1980s and 1990s. Players take on the role of Zhao Hongbing, navigating the criminal underworld, shifting power struggles, romance, and bonds of brotherhood. Directed by the original novel's author, Kong Ergou, the game features returning cast members from the screen adaptation. Player choices influence relationships, story branches, and multiple possible endings. The game recreates the era through detailed environments and explores themes of loyalty, betrayal, friendship, and ambition.

releases.title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra
releases.synopsis: Disrupt dark magicks and put an end to the powerful witchcraft of the Coven Queen in Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra.

releases.title: A.N.S.I.A.
releases.synopsis: It's your first day at ANSIA. Review citizens' paperwork according to regulations that change every day, growing more absurd by the minute. A satire of Italian bureaucracy inspired by Papers, Please, with 4 different endings.

releases.title: Beekeeper Simulator
releases.synopsis: Beekeeper Simulator puts you in the shoes of a dedicated beekeeper, where you'll care for buzzing hives, harvest a variety of honey types, and expand your operations to build a thriving beekeeping empire. Nurture your bees, optimize your apiary, and turn your passion into profit!

releases.title: Dark Workshop Simulator
releases.synopsis: Dark Workshop Simulator is a first-person dark fantasy shop simulator. The player runs an emporium serving adventurers, alchemists and monsters: ordering from suppliers, stocking shelves, setting prices and fulfilling contracts. Potions, blades and tomes are crafted at alchemy, forge and library stations by tracing sigils, and crafters can be hired to work them. Grime builds up over time and attracts customers, thieves must be caught, and hostile creatures are fought off with a hammer. World events such as plagues, wars and edicts reshape market demand. The shop expands with new rooms, zombie staff and a Grimoire skill tree of permanent upgrades.

releases.title: Moga TD
releases.synopsis: Moga TD is a cooperative tower defense game for up to four players. Each player controls a builder with its own race of towers and defends one corner of a shared board against 41 waves of creeps, ending with the Orc Warlord. Players share one pool of lives, earn Gold to build and upgrade towers, and must coordinate their defenses to win. Online co-op runs through Steam lobbies.

releases.title: Logosmancer
releases.synopsis: A 5v5 wizard battler where every spell is cast with your voice. Yell FIREBALL, FREEZE, FLY, TRANSFORM or FART to fight in King of the Hill, Team Deathmatch and Free-for-All, or survive co-op waves in Sandbox.

releases.title: Knurlworm
releases.synopsis: Knurlworm is a short character-driven game where every visual asset is made from real woodcut stamps pressed onto real paper. Watch a lone Carver's story unfold print by print as he searches for a mythical worm said to be able to change a person's fate. The Knurlworm.

releases.title: Pawhold: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game
releases.synopsis: Somewhere out there, an AI keeps generating worlds and enemies to conquer mankind. Your cats are on the task. An idle pixel squad shooter that lives along the bottom of your screen while you work: four cat commandos fight, you click to help, bank the bounty and refit the crew.

releases.title: No More Monsters
releases.synopsis: It's time to challenge the monsters of Arvelia! Become one of the world's mightiest mages, slay thousands of creatures, and claim their power. They thought this world belonged to them. Prove them wrong. They used to be the hunters. Now they're the prey. No More Monsters!

releases.title: Piercing
releases.synopsis: PIERCING is a rhythm-action game where you smash every panel to the beat. Fail, and the Contract forces you to give your childhood friend a piercing.

releases.title: Kinsoku Ryokan
releases.synopsis: Follow the ever-changing taboos, complete your exorcism missions, and make it back alive. A horror action game featuring the story of Satomi, an apprentice shrine maiden, and online play for up to 8 players.

releases.title: QUTAS67: Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067
releases.synopsis: Every criminal starts somewhere. You start in a dumpster. Welcome to Miami, 2067, where the economy is a joke and you’ve decided to become the punchline. Click to earn cash, upgrade your Click Power and work your way through 20 locations, from parking lots to banks and museums. Your goal? Stealing The Legendary Game the whole world has been waiting for. Apparently, asking nicely wasn't an option.

releases.title: Hellterns
releases.synopsis: A chaotic co-op work sim set in Hell for 1–4 players. Catch sinful souls, put them through absurd machines, stamp their papers, and send them to Heaven before your shift ends. Fires, brawls, and write-ups included.

releases.title: Goblin and Glory
releases.synopsis: Build your goblin crew, upgrade your sword, and fight through 10 dungeons! Goblin & Glory is a pixel-art clicker game with auto-attacking helpers, relic choices, and 60-second boss battles. Earn prestige, unlock permanent abilities, and return stronger with every run.

releases.title: We March as One
releases.synopsis: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.

releases.title: Business Tycoon
releases.synopsis: Build a business empire across the United States. Create companies, open and upgrade assets. Expand across industries, dominate markets, control a growing share of the economy, and build a trillion-dollar fortune.

releases.title: Zombies Aren't Real
releases.synopsis: Zombies aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you deploy military forces in an attempt to quell a quick-spreading zombie infection and save as many civilians as you can!

releases.title: Blowhole
releases.synopsis: You're a dolphin. Your job: make everything sparkle by spitting high-pressure water. 1–6 players, seagulls with a grudge, crazy modifiers and absolutely zero professionalism.

releases.title: Escape Your Boss
releases.synopsis: Escape Your Boss is a 2D pixel-art action platformer. Jean-Michel, an overworked accountant, wants to leave the office in time to watch the France–Brazil match at 8:45 PM, but his boss has locked down the whole floor. Dressed as a ninja, he fights his way down Megacorp Tower floor by floor, facing coworkers, security guards and office-themed bosses. The campaign can be played solo or in online co-op with up to four players. The game also includes a level editor and bonus modes.

releases.title: Battlegenics
releases.synopsis: A unique roguelike word fusing mutant breeding game! Fuse the monsters and the words into one creature. Form an army of mutants and battle the world! Or play with a friend and fuse parts together.

releases.title: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
releases.synopsis: Build your own computer club from an empty lot: rows of gaming PCs, console and VR corners, a bar and a kitchen. Hire staff, keep gamers happy, deal with 21 city factions — and don't forget to pet Luna, the club cat.

releases.title: Zombie Crawlers
releases.synopsis: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! Zombie Crawlers a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

releases.title: The Eggsortist
releases.synopsis: A chicken possessed by the Devil has laid 4,266 colored eggs in a barn, but 666 of them are demonic eggs in disguise! Sort the eggs, find the evil impostors, and burn them before they hatch and doom the world.

releases.title: Malignus
releases.synopsis: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.

releases.title: Parcel Inspector Simulator
releases.synopsis: Parcel Inspector Simulator is a first-person inspection sim set on the night shift of a transit post office in 1962. Every parcel that crosses the desk is weighed, X-rayed, checked under a UV lamp, listened to with a probe and looked up in the terminal, then stamped: approve, return to sender, hold, dispose or confiscate. Regulations change from night to night, wages pay for desk upgrades and for a brother's sanatorium bills, and a 20-night story campaign with seven endings follows a favour that somebody upstairs keeps asking for. After the campaign the shifts go on as endless nights with special conditions.

releases.title: Yoyo Blade
releases.synopsis: Master a tethered blade in a mouse-only incremental action game. Throw it, build up speed, and upgrade it to fight back waves of enemies before corruption consumes your world.

releases.title: Bannerlings
releases.synopsis: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.

releases.title: CarCrash.Tube: Car Crash Simulator
releases.synopsis: Create crazy crash scenarios, wreck cars, and capture the chaos! Share your best videos on your channel, gain new followers, and increase your earnings. Buy new vehicles and equipment, create bigger crashes, and take your CarCrash.Tube channel to the top!

releases.title: Frontier Tale
releases.synopsis: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

releases.title: Dusteroids
releases.synopsis: Dusteroids is a satisfying space-themed incremental game. Fill the screen with bullets, destroy asteroids, upgrade your ship & do it all again! Do you have what it takes to seek the stars?

releases.title: Provinces
releases.synopsis: Provinces is a compact turn-based strategy game about leading your one and only army across a medievalish war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, storm rival capitals and watch your tiny soldiers deal with the consequences in fast, automatic battles.

releases.title: Dice Hoarder
releases.synopsis: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

releases.title: 10 Million Pixels
releases.synopsis: Mine through millions of pixels to find the one golden pixel. A mesmerizing incremental game about exploration and erosion.

releases.title: Extract Survivors
releases.synopsis: Extraction survivors-like meets deep ARPG Loot. Fight endless hordes across deadly floors, extract, then roll, gamble, and upgrade gear across 10 tiers of modifiers and powerful Uniques to forge a game-breaking build. One life. Permadeath. Infinite loot. How deep can you fall?

releases.title: Warrior Quest
releases.synopsis: Warrior Quest is a single-player, text-driven dark-fantasy RPG where old-school dungeon crawling meets next-gen, free-form, offline AI diplomacy. Fight, sneak, negotiate in your own words, recruit unlikely companions... and whatever you do, roll well.

releases.title: Epoch Vault
releases.synopsis: Bring life back to a world shattered by Earth’s greatest mass extinction. Discover ancient creatures, watch ecosystems recover, and trace life’s journey from the survivors to the rise of the first dinosaurs in an atmospheric idle game set in the Triassic.

releases.title: Satelital
releases.synopsis: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

releases.title: Node Zero
releases.synopsis: Investigate system failures, trace corrupted infrastructure, and keep the node alive before stability reaches zero. NODE ZERO is an interface-driven psychological horror game where something inside the system is learning how you work.

releases.title: Grandma Left Me A Building
releases.synopsis: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

releases.title: ChickenPlaguePolice
releases.synopsis: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.

releases.title: Sol One
releases.synopsis: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.

releases.title: Fancy Farm Brawl
releases.synopsis: Closed Playtest Now Live! Mix relaxing farming & tower defense. Early testers average over 98 minutes per play session. Click Request Access on store page to apply for limited slots.

releases.title: Hands Over
releases.synopsis: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

releases.title: Deathly Delights
releases.synopsis: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.

releases.title: Slay the Q
releases.synopsis: Roguelike deck builder where you summon creatures to fight for you. Gain gold, buy magical Artifacts, enchance Cards with Runes, and create powerful combinations.

releases.title: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
releases.synopsis: 【Village-Building Action RPG】 Saved by a goddess, you arrive in a ruined world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, swap hats to change classes and give villagers their roles. But one night, the Idol Demon King holds a Live next door...and monsters come pouring in!?
